Measured

Image Inpainting Desktop CPU Baseline

Compare MI-GAN-512 and Telea on identical inputs, with p50, p95, masked PSNR, and per-run samples.

12th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i9-12900KS desktop CPU with ONNX Runtime 1.19.2, OpenCV 4.11.0. 768 × 512 RGB, batch 1, and 4 threads. 5 warm-ups and 30 samples per scene and method.

CPU measurements by scene and method
SceneMethodp50 (ms)p95 (ms)Masked PSNR (dB)
HallwayMI-GAN-512529.85572.85623.37
HallwayOpenCV Telea6.66.74422.75
ForestMI-GAN-512524.292649.69213.19
ForestOpenCV Telea6.156.35414.04

Timing covers prepared image and mask to restored RGB, including MI-GAN pre/postprocessing and compositing. Masked PSNR compares uncompressed pixels with the reference background. MI-GAN leads on PSNR in the hallway, and Telea leads in the forest.

Device deployment and remaining measurements

Target NPU/GPU latency, peak memory, power, precision variants, automatic segmentation, and video temporal consistency are not yet measured. The CPU host OS version was unrecorded.

Controlled Single-GPU Scheduling Trace

Scheduling events and per-process VRAM samples from two CUDA jobs and one CPU job.

One 24 GiB GPU, 1 GPU slot, and 2 execution slots. Each CUDA fixture allocates 32 MiB. Wait is start minus submission, and duration is completion minus start.

Timing and memory derived from the three-job trace
JobWait (s)Run (s)GPU reservation (MiB)Peak sampled process VRAM (MiB)Exit code
GPU A0.7138.3895122860
GPU B9.0995.3615122860
CPU C0.6325.3170—0

Peak values are sampled per-process VRAM including the CUDA context. The public trace supports checking admission order and concurrent CPU work. GPU utilization, production throughput, and multi-GPU scaling are not yet measured.

Simulated

Four-Stage Photonic Mesh Fault

Model outputs for a specified input and fault condition.

The first input port has 100% normalized power. Cell 2-23 has a +35° phase offset and 20% local attenuation.

Simulated power at ideal and faulted output ports
Output portIdeal normalized powerFaulted normalized power
10.2386910.33135
20.0543180.031395
30.6683180.542469
40.0386730.016107

The model estimates a 7.868% reduction in total power with ideal 50:50 couplers. Fabrication parameters, drift, detector noise, and physical chip benchmarks are not yet measured.

Paper Evidence Quote and Number Checks

Four synthetic inputs and recorded outcomes from pinned open source.

A pinned public verification core checks numbers within 200 characters on either side of the quote, with fuzzy matching disabled.

Replay results for four synthetic inputs
FixtureStatusDecision
Exact quoteEXACTPassed
Normalized quoteNORMALIZEDPassed
Out-of-context numberNUM_FAILBlocked
Unlocated quoteFAILBlocked

The outcomes cover four deterministic synthetic inputs. Claim truth, semantic interpretation, and overall model accuracy need separate validation.
